Print speed cannot be verified from photos. The model number is needed to confirm if this printer supports 42 ppm.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Kyocera monochrome laser all-in-one, not as the high-speed m2540dn.

risks.risk: The printer may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in the photo.
